name: Bun Guard
summary: A meadow sign-in page where a bunny peeks over the card and folds her ears over her eyes
about: A full sign-in page on a drifting spring meadow, guarded by Mallow the bunny who peeks over the top of the card with her paws on the edge. She sniffs and watches the caret as you type, folds her long ears down over her eyes for the password and lifts one ear to peek when you show it. Good for a friendly login on a pet brand, a kids product or any cosy app.
how: The meadow rolls in, the card pops up and Mallow peeks over its top edge, ears twitching
Focus the email field: her ears perk up and her eyes and head follow the caret while her nose sniffs with each key
Move to the password: both ears flop down over her eyes; press Show password and one ear lifts so she can peek
Press Sign in: she drums her paws while a carrot gets nibbled in the button
Correct details make her hop for joy with hearts and carrots; wrong ones droop her ears with a little tear
Fill demo types the working login for you, and Sign out brings the form back
